invariants.rationale: The method calls to.length() and to.substring(...), so null would cause a NullPointerException.
The method uses position as an index in substring; negative values would cause an exception.
substring's second argument can be equal to to.length(), so this ensures position is not out of bounds.
The method returns text.toString(); if text were null, this would throw a NullPointerException.
String.length() always returns a non-negative integer.
